post_measurement_build.scope: Only feature-off branch typing changed to Infallible to pass default Clippy; enabled machine-code section is byte-identical. Performance numbers refer to the preserved A979 measured binary, not relabeled as a new full-binary measurement.

changes: Borrow qualified direct-Rust request state/config/observation; clone committed state once for mutation; return typed response state by move.
Count exact expanded request and Python ASCII/spaced response sizes without allocating full encoded buffers. Counted limits retain deadlines and action limits.
Reuse complete event stamps only inside the exact immutable market wave, keyed by all observation and filter parameters.
Share immutable per-wave receipts, account events and receipt indices; release the market history mutex before hashing private account history.
Borrow full historical prefixes for equality checks instead of cloning them. Full prefixes, speculative-session checks and journal schema remain unchanged.
limitations: Optional direct Rust path remains default off; original source qualification and process fallback unchanged.
Two short serial runs per version; async trades may differ due to scheduling. Fixed receipts are exact.
Memory-journal load comparison; PostgreSQL restart is separate correctness evidence, not database capacity.
Nested phase wall times overlap and cannot be added. Phase deltas include final quiescence.
No production capacity or long-duration qualification. No commit or push.
